result.sign_convention: delta = exchange(CYP11B2) - exchange(CYP11B1); negative favors B2 in this energy model
result.interpretation: Potential-energy exchange descriptor; not a binding free energy or measured selectivity.

preference_summary.headline: UMA exchange favors CYP11B2
preference_summary.scope: Direction for this prepared exchange calculation only; not a binding or selectivity verdict. Robustness across poses/states has not been established.
preference_summary.why_no_fold: An equilibrium fold ratio requires a binding free-energy difference and temperature. This UMA exchange potential energy omits the required thermodynamic sampling / contributions; exponentiating it or dividing total energies does not yield selectivity.

energy_fold_proxy.label: Hypothetical energy-fold proxy
warnings: Extreme, unvalidated magnitude: exponentiation amplifies the exchange-energy difference. Do not interpret this number as biological selectivity or confidence.
energy_fold_proxy.scope: Uncalibrated, hypothetical Boltzmann energy proxy only. Not binding selectivity, an affinity/Kd prediction, or an equilibrium population ratio. Potential energy has not been established as binding free energy; experimental cross-checks and thermodynamic validation are required.
